theme: Last day before Croatia — close the loops.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is clear, but tomorrow evening you fly to Croatia for twelve days and the charter has almost no signal — so today is for every booking and reply that can't be done from a boat.

needsAttention.title: Dubrovnik host needs your arrival time
needsAttention.detail: Damjan, host of your Sept 9–12 Old Port apartment, messaged asking you to confirm your arrival time. Worth answering before you're in transit tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat night and transfer for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: The post-charter room in Cavtat and the noon Komolac transfer still aren't booked, and connectivity dies once you board on the 12th. This has to happen from dry land today. (P1)

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap, Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: You land Tampa Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until the 22nd — two nights in St Pete still unbooked, and not something you can arrange mid-charter. (P1)

needsAttention.title: Checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on the Eurowings Discover site and buy bags now if needed, before airport-counter rates tomorrow. (P1)

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: This was due Sept 5 and the Oct 18 rotation booking fires while you're at sea. Decide before you leave, not from the boat. (P2)

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann wants to reconnect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn InMail asking whether you're still at KPMG and pitching his fundraising platform — a networking reply awaiting you, low urgency.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day sales, newsletters, a Central Maine Power autopay receipt, and a Todoist digest — nothing that needs you.

recipe.title: Quinces Poached in Muscat
recipe.why: Quinces come into season in early autumn, and a slow poach in sweet wine turns their hard flesh silky and amber.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip
Decide the Sept 20–Oct 5 car: refundable rental or Mike's car
Confirm boarding time and return transfer with the Nautilus instructor
Finish the Nautilus Masterclass videos (~68% done)

acts.line: A clear calendar and a short stack of trip bookings that all share one deadline — the moment you board on the 12th.
Close the Croatia loops that need a signal: the Cavtat night, the St Pete gap, the baggage allowance.
Last night with the girls before the handoff, and tomorrow's 5:55 PM flight out of Tampa — the two Black Hole duffels get packed.
